lines.text: Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat became king of Judah at thirty-two and reigned in Jerusalem eight years.
Jehoram did evil like the house of Ahab, yet the LORD would not destroy Judah because of His servant Abraham.
Edom rebelled against Judah and appointed its own king, and Jehoram attacked by night at Zair.
Jehoram was buried in Samaria, and his son Ahaziah became king at twenty-two and reigned one year.
Ahaziah went with Joram to fight Hazael at Ramoth-gilead, and Ahaziah later visited the wounded Joram in Jezreel.
